WorkerHello11.description: A version-aware host intersects these names with its implemented allowlist. The advertised envelope version must be present. A 1.0 compatibility operation uses its own exact 1.0 frames.

SharedSelection11.description: A committed shared selection. Hover and temporary navigation are local presentation; changing the selected evidence advances selection_revision without requiring a persistent edit.

MutationScope11.description: The core derives the principal, client, session and current grant from the authenticated transport. These fields select the requested target only.

DeclarativeSource11.description: Bind unique declared parameter names, type-check overrides and materialize defaults before hashing. Resolve named windows to positive integers. Evaluate numeric series separately from boolean marker predicates. A false or unknown predicate emits no marker.

WorkspaceFault11.description: A core-sanitized error for this recipient. Do not pass provider, grant, path or model diagnostics through this view.

PythonExecutionScope11.description: Core-issued disclosure. Requires effective data rights and a human decision about this exact execution. File and network access are not technically isolated.

TrustedConfirmationDecision11.description: Trusted human UI to core only. The authenticated transport identifies the approver. This is never an advertised AI tool or a worker-originated request.

IndexedIndicatorArtifact11.description: An immutable artifact staged under the task's limits. The core only publishes a preview after validating and hashing the complete result.

PreviewReady11.description: Core-issued terminal preview notification. Resolve only the validated output for this task, draft, immutable snapshot and parameter set. A worker cannot publish an accepted preview.

ArtifactChunk11.description: Ordered segments carry bytes of the same canonical IndicatorResult JSON and are individually subject to the NDJSON byte cap. Validate the full content hash, declared sizes and output semantics before exposure. Dispose incomplete or cancelled staging.

CancelMemberRequest11.description: Host to the worker that owns this outstanding request. A cancellation never rolls back an earlier committed operation.

ExportedBar11.description: Emit only requested and permitted fields. Missing denotes withheld/not requested; null volume denotes a permitted observation of unknown volume.

ProjectedChart11.description: Use recipient-safe opaque source/revision references. Every row must have exactly the listed fields; if required provenance cannot be disclosed, deny the read. Nested source metadata is not included.

ToolRefResult11.description: A grant-filtered opaque result or task reference. Redeeming a reference must repeat current grant and entitlement checks.

AiToolResultDelivery11.description: Core-to-AI control message. Match the active task and call before accepting a result. Acknowledgement of this delivery does not establish execution success.

IndicatorCompute11.description: Core to indicator worker after authorization. Supply the frozen bars directly or through bounded matching input segments. Workers cannot fetch the user's database or approve computation.

IndicatorComputed11.description: Untrusted worker output. The core checks complete bytes, identities, sizes and result semantics before issuing any preview ID.

CsvMappingV1.description: An editable mapping. Unfinished native declarations may produce diagnostics alongside raw rows.

review_revision.description: Monotonic review revision assigned by the profile-bound writer for this source association.

header_sha256.description: Application-derived SHA-256 of the ordered source columns with the reviewed encoding and delimiter.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the current complete file when an earlier review exists.

DecisionNoteEvidenceRef.description: A local, attributed evidence reference as it was known when the user made the decision.

DecisionNoteReadOutput.description: A page of summaries when no note ID was requested, or the original and a page of separately dated outcomes for the requested note.

PrivateRecordChangeScope11.description: The trusted local host supplies the profile and principal. Restore targets the private decision-note collection in the bound workspace.

PrivateRecordContent.description: Explicitly saved typed local content. Conversation turns are in entered order. Text must be nonblank; each encoded content object is limited to 8 KiB.

PrivateRecordBackupV1.description: A profile- and workspace-bound logical backup. It carries only current records and known deleted IDs. The local restore merges missing records, preserves current corrections, applies known tombstones and never restores outbound grants. Maximum size is 512 KiB.

PrivateRecordReceipt11.description: A body-free receipt. An archive merge can change several records and carries no record ID. Private record writes have no undo payload.

PrivateRecordReadCommand11.description: Trusted local human workspace entry. Unavailable to worker, model and paired-client transports.

PrivateRecordChangeCommand11.description: Trusted local human workspace entry. Unavailable to worker, model and paired-client transports.

PrivateRecordExportCommand11.description: Trusted local human workspace entry. Unavailable to worker, model and paired-client transports.

DecisionNoteReceipt11.description: A body-free receipt. Deletion and the other decision-note changes carry no workspace undo payload.

DecisionNoteWriteScope11.description: The profile and principal are supplied by the local host. A decision note is selected independently of shared chart evidence.

DecisionNoteConfirmation11.description: A decision submitted through the trusted local human interface for an exact pending request.

DecisionNoteSaveCommand11.description: Private local workspace request. The worker protocol cannot carry it.

DecisionNoteReadCommand11.description: Private local workspace request. The worker protocol cannot carry it.

DecisionNoteAppendOutcomeCommand11.description: Private local workspace request. The worker protocol cannot carry it.

DecisionNoteDeleteCommand11.description: Private local workspace request. The worker protocol cannot carry it.

DecisionNoteBackupDeletion.description: Body-free deletion marker from the same profile and workspace.

DecisionNoteBackupV1.description: Versioned local decision-note archive. The core also limits the compact UTF-8 archive to 512 KiB.

DecisionNoteRestoreScope11.description: The trusted local host supplies the profile and principal. Restore targets the private decision-note collection in the bound workspace.

DecisionNoteRestoreSummary.description: A body-free merge preview. The warning indicates that an independent older copy may contain notes whose deletion markers are unavailable.

DecisionNoteRestoreBackupInput.description: Resolve an exact staged restore in the issuing local session. The request carries no archive body.

DecisionNoteExportBackupCommand11.description: Private local workspace request. The worker protocol cannot carry it.

DecisionNotePreviewRestoreCommand11.description: Private local workspace request. The worker protocol cannot carry it.

DecisionNoteRestoreBackupCommand11.description: Private local workspace request. The worker protocol cannot carry it.

LocalImportRevisionBarSummary.description: Frozen chart endpoints in bar timestamp order and the final bar's close. The dates are the stored trading days.

after_revision_id.description: Exclusive lower bound in ascending canonical revision ID order. Use null for the first page.

include_bar_summary.description: When true, include bar_summary on each entitled entry. Omission and false preserve the legacy response shape.

next_after_revision_id.description: The final returned revision ID if more entitled rows existed in this read, otherwise null.
